notes.title: 🐸 Frog Galaxy Survivor is Back!
notes.content: [p]🐸 Hello, friends![/p][p]You may remember that the original developer, Hunt Games, was forced to pause work on Frog Galaxy Survivor due to difficulties and the large amount of work ahead. This was truly sad news, as the game had already won the hearts of many players with its engaging gameplay and vibrant style. It would be a real shame to leave such a promising project unfinished.[/p][p]💥 That’s why we, the team at Whale Rock Games, decided to give Frog Galaxy Survivor another chance! We’re excited to continue development and bring the game all the way to a full release. Here’s what we have planned:[/p][p]🎮 Completely rework the gameplay foundation, turning it into a truly captivating vampire survivor-like[/p][p]🌌 Add new locations with unique enemies and mechanics[/p][p]🔫 Expand Frogus’s arsenal — expect even more powerful and stylish weapons[/p][p]🎯 Refresh the interface — modern, user-friendly, and pleasing to the eye[/p][p]🛠 Fix bugs and implement many other improvements[/p][p]We’d also love to hear your thoughts: what do you think about the current version of the game, and what do you feel it’s missing? Your feedback will help us shape the game into exactly what you want it to be.[/p][p]Thank you for staying with us. Frog Galaxy Survivor is coming back — and this is just the beginning of its journey![/p][p]🚀 With love,[/p][p]The Whale Rock Games Team[/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3083360/Frog_Galaxy_Survivor/?beta=1" style="button"]Add to Wishlist[/url][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31645359/835bcb8e20ef4fca633d6ad883ee9236d3f7f1c2.jpg"][/img]  [/p]

notes.title: Deployment is coming April 10, 2018
notes.content:
Hi there, fans!

We are thankful for your attention over the years. We had managed to release We Are The Dwarves on PC, 
PS4 and Xbox ONE and this would be impossible without your active support. 
We really enjoyed communicating with you guys and its time to move on.

Our latest project Deployment is something special we've been working on last years.
The game is set in a futuristic environment and offers a highly competitive fast and joyful multiplayer gameplay.

Go and check this out:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/755980/Deployment/

Deployment is an online Top Down Shooter supporting up to 10 players on single map. 
The goal of the game is to win a match using remote level mechanics, which we call Systems.
By activating System, you gain an advantage over the enemies in the room. But the system is tough to hold because everyone wants to control them.
This creates a unique gameplay situations, which are kind of rare to the genre.

We hope you will enjoy the game and we are looking for your active support. 
Let us know what you think. 

Write comments, subscribe, add to the wish lists, tell your friends - all of these will be a great help to the project.

The game is releasing April 10, 2018.

notes.title: Update 8
notes.content:
Hi, friends.
We proudly introduce the new, major update.
During porting "We Are The Dwarves" to XBox One(released on 24 of Feb) and PS4 (release will be in a few weeks) we made a lot of tweaks. Here is the short list of them:
1. Improved performance
2. Improved game difficulty
3. Added resources on the levels
4. Fixed gamepad issues on Win 10 (1607)
5. Fixed glitches on Mac and Linux and some AMD graphic cards
6. Fixed lighting serialization bug
7. Improved drowning speed on normal and hard difficulty
8. Fixed game music bug on save/load
9. Fixed interactive objects missing animations
10. Added localization languages(Spanish, Portuguese, Czech)
Hope, you will be satisfied with these update:)

notes.title: Update 6
notes.content:
Hello!
Here’s the new update.
We’re happy to tell you that we’ve added the local cooperative mode to the game and that’s a big deal!
Now you can play We Are The Dwarves with your friends. 
Try it out and tell us your impressions!

Release notes:
New local cooperative mode + 4 levels for it. (Only gamepads supported in it)
Variety of mechanics and features tweaks and improvements for cooperative mode

Changed logics of some character abilities(improved targetiing and using for gamepads)
Fixed character abilities bugs
Fixed a lot of UI-related bugs
Simplified spacesuit repair mechanics(Star Crust removed from the game. Suit is repaired with Energy Ore now)
No need to charge spacesuit's systems no more. They will work while corresponding suit cell is unbroken.
Perfomance optimization
Mac and Linux related issues fixed
A lot of different bugs fixed

Know Issues:
2 Xbox One gamepads will not work properly (Unity bug)
Mouse cursor appears while fine abilities targetting with gamepad is made
Multiplayer camera issues(When someone falls, gets out of the camera frustrum)
Hot plugging sometimes works incorrectly. Please restart game when plugged new controller

notes.title: Update 5
notes.content:
Hi, friends!
It's been a while since the last update.
We worked hard fixing bugs, optimizing performance, tweaking balance.
And I'm glad to introduce the Update 5.
One of the most exciting feature that we would like to share in this update is a controller support.
We tested and supported XBox One, DualShock 4 and Steam controller. Other controllers should work as well.

So, the release notes are:
- gamepad support (including huge UI rework for proper gamepad navigation, detection)
- autopickup for all pickable resources added(no more pixel hunting needed!)
- gameplay and balance tweaks
- updated game difficulty screen
- fixed save-related bugs
- fixed a lot of UI bugs

Known issues:
- rarely black characters screen on Mac

Fixed aiming on humanoid creatures.

According to the poor quality of localized texts we decided to remove the major part of localization from the main Steam page until it will be fixed.
All languages are still in the game, but now they have "unofficial" state.
Sorry for that! Stay tuned for the next update!

notes.title: First Update Announce
notes.content:
Hi, friends!
We want to inform you that we are working on a first update based on a comments and feedback we've received from you.
The update will include:
1) An easier game difficulty with tougher dwarves in it.
2) Save on demand for an easier game difficulty to give you an opportunity to save near some enemies and discover different ways to slay them!
3) Hotkeys remapping available in the game options.
4) Enabled by default standard pop-up options window for selection main display, resolution.


And sorry for the weird translation to some Asian and Europian languages. It seems that we were cheated by our translators.

Thank you all so much for following our development; we can't to see what you think next Friday!
